name: Free Upsell & Cross-Sell Editor for WooCommerce – Bulk, Variations & Discounts
author: Affinsy

sections.description:
Tired of opening dozens of product pages just to link a few upsells or cross-sells? Free Upsell & Cross-Sell Editor for WooCommerce is a free, table-based editor right in your WooCommerce dashboard. Edit hundreds of products in bulk — and, unlike the built-in linked-products box, link variations: suggest the matching size of the pants when a shopper picks a shirt size, and give it a discount that only applies when both are in the cart.

Free forever. No premium version, no locked features.

Key Features

  • Fast Bulk Editing: Add or remove upsells and cross-sells for multiple products at once.
  • Dynamic Product Search: Instantly search for products by name or SKU to link them.
  • Custom Cross-Sell Discounts: Offer a percentage discount on a cross-sell product, but only when the “trigger” product is in the cart.
  • For Variations: Link up-sells and cross-sells to individual variations — and to individual variations of other products. The product page updates live as the shopper picks a variation, and the suggested variation opens pre-selected.
  • With Discounts: Give any cross-sell a percentage discount that applies in the cart only while the trigger product (or variation) is there. Shoppers see a “Special Offer” hint on the product page and the reduced price in the cart.
  • Copy & Paste: Copy upsell/cross-sell settings from one product and paste them to others instantly.
  • Export / Import CSV: Back up all linked products to a simple CSV (id:discount lists), edit it in a spreadsheet and import it back. Every import shows a review screen listing exactly what will be added, removed or changed before anything is written.
  • Intuitive Interface: A clean, filterable table makes managing your product relationships simple.

This plugin is designed to save you time and help you increase your average order value through strategic product recommendations.

💡 Pro Tip: Don’t just guess what sells well together. Use Affinsy to run a full Market Basket Analysis and discover your store’s most profitable product combinations scientifically.

How variation links work

The rule is simple: the parent product’s links are the defaults, a variation’s links are extras.

  • Links set on a variable product apply to every variation.
  • Links set on a variation are shown in addition to the parent’s, only when that variation is selected.
  • If a target is a specific variation (e.g. Pants – M), it replaces the plain Pants entry in the list and opens with that size pre-selected.
  • Before a variation is selected, the page shows the parent’s links plus the variations’ targets collapsed to their parent product — so Pants appears once, not once per size.
  • Discounts never stack. If both the parent and the variation discount the same product, the higher percentage wins.
  • Reciprocal discounts (A discounts B and B discounts A) are allowed and simply act as a bundle deal.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bulk-upsell-cross-sell-editor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Bulk Linked Products to start editing.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Fixed: variation-level up-sells and cross-sells now persist and display. WooCommerce never stores these for variations, so they are kept in plugin meta and rendered on the product page when a variation is selected.
  • Fixed: cart discounts now apply when an offer targets a variable product and a variation of it is in the cart (and vice versa).
  • Fixed: pasted / added tags rendered a stray “%%” and did not escape product names.
  • New: CSV import shows a preview of all additions, removals and discount changes and asks for confirmation before applying.
  • New: simpler CSV format (Upsell IDs, Cross-sell IDs as id:discount). Old exports still import.
  • Copy/Paste and search never let a product link to itself.
  • “Include Variations” and the category filter apply immediately.
  • Links to a specific variation (variation → variation) open the target product with that variation pre-selected.
  • “Frequently bought together” now shows the discounted price and a “20% off together” badge up front — on the product page and in the cart — instead of only after the other product is added.
  • Fixed: bundled translations (de, es, fr, it, nl, pl) were never loaded because the plugin did not call load_plugin_textdomain(). All new strings translated; plural forms fixed.
  • Variations without their own SKU: the editor and CSV export show the variation’s real (blank) SKU instead of the inherited parent SKU; a CSV variation row without an ID whose SKU resolves to the parent is skipped with a warning instead of silently updating the parent.
  • Clear rules for parent vs. variation links: parent links are defaults, variation links are extras; variation targets replace their parent product; before a variation is selected, variation targets are collapsed to their parent product. See “How variation links work”.

1.2.0

  • Improved variation editing: variations now show parent name, attributes, and product ID for easier identification.
  • Better disambiguation of products sharing the same SKU.
  • Added Copy & Paste and Export/Import features to readme description.
  • Rebranded to Affinsy.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
